::: {.callout-important title="Fictional example"}
The department, the notes, and the priorities are invented for teaching. Do not copy the levels: your group discovers its own.
:::

## What the example shows

The chart on page 2 shows a completed Panarchy chart after the vote.

- **Priority 1, department level:** nobody owns the guidance on AI use. A fast level waits for a slow one.
- **Priority 2, university level:** the licensed chatbot has no documentation of its training data, so disclosures stay vague.
- **Priority 3, vendor level:** license terms restrict what users can document.
- **Upward:** a disclosure template from the department can become university policy.
- **Downward:** a legal duty to document training data supports stricter procurement.
